description: Source file implementing FastAPI routes for managing jobs, assets, and analysis workflows in a branding compliance backend. It includes endpoints for creating, deleting, uploading assets, starting analysis, fetching status/results, fixing assets, and downloading reports.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new job, with optional owner, title, description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status of a job, including progress metrics and timestamps.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Request model for fixing a single asset with an optional strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request model for batch fixing assets with issues, with optional strategy.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new job, initializing workspace and JSON state, returning job ID.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a specified job and its workspace.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a zip of assets, extract into workspace uploads.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload an old brand reference image.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a new brand reference image.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Trigger background analysis of uploaded assets, manage job status, and handle errors.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieve current status and progress metrics of a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Fetch assets, issues, and summary data for a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Serve preview images for assets in original, overlay, or fixed views.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Run fix process on a single asset, returning output path and public URL.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Run automatic fixes on all assets with issues, returning outputs and URLs.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Prepare and serve downloadable report or zip artifacts for a job.
